lablup-2026.tagline: Backend.AI, the de facto standard for Korean GPU/AI infrastructure — full-stack MLOps

founders.background: PhD from KAIST, asyncio and Python core contributor
founders.notable_achievement: The person who turned open-source 'Backend.AI' into the de facto standard MLOps platform for the South Korean government and large enterprises

founders.background: PhD from KAIST, researcher in distributed computing and AI infrastructure
founders.notable_achievement: Designed Backend.AI's distributed GPU scheduler and session system

lablup-2026.team_highlights: Distributed systems engineers from KAIST and Seoul National University, open-source core contributors, and personnel collaborating with government and research institutions

product.summary: Backend.AI is an AI/HPC container orchestration platform operated under a dual open-source + enterprise license. It provides GPU resource virtualization, session management, and MLOps workflows in a single package, establishing itself as the standard in data centers of the South Korean government, research institutes, and large enterprises.
product.problem_statement: South Korean government agencies, research institutes, and large enterprises need to operate NVIDIA GPU clusters, but Kubernetes alone makes it difficult for ML researchers and students to freely use GPUs, with billing and isolation challenges.
product.solution: An orchestrator that virtualizes and allocates GPU resources in fGPU units and integrates notebook, session, and service modes. It offers a proprietary container runtime and a researcher-friendly UI.
key_features: Backend.AI: GPU container orchestrator
fGPU: GPU resource virtualization and partitioning
Sokovan: proprietary container runtime
FastTrack: multi-tenant for government and research institutes
Cloud / On-Premises dual deployment
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: GPU virtualization and partitioning IP, proprietary container runtime, ML workflow orchestration
product.target_customer: South Korean government and research institutes (KAIST, KISTI), large enterprise R&D data centers, universities and educational institutions, global GPU cloud providers
product.business_model: Open source + enterprise license + cloud SaaS + government and research contracts

direct_competitors.comparison: Global leader in GPU orchestration. Backend.AI differentiates with deep Korean market presence and government/research friendliness.
ML training platform. Lablup differentiates with broader integration of notebooks, sessions, and services.
Global ML infrastructure. Lablup differentiates with on-premises and government data center friendliness.

competitive_landscape.moat: De facto standard status among South Korean government, research institutes, and large enterprises; open-source community; fGPU and Sokovan IP
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: The leading player in the Korean AI infrastructure category, with strength in government, research, and large enterprise markets

mathpresso-qanda-2026.tagline: QANDA — AI math solver app used by 800M students, EdTech champion in Southeast Asia and Japan

founders.background: Graduate of Seoul National University; serial entrepreneur who started from experience as a private institute instructor and tutor
founders.notable_achievement: First South Korean EdTech to rank No.1 in Southeast Asia, Japan, and the Middle East; grew QANDA into a global AI learning platform

founders.background: Seoul National University graduate; mobile product expert
founders.notable_achievement: Designed QANDA mobile app and teacher matching system

mathpresso-qanda-2026.team_highlights: Founders from Seoul National University + AI/education content specialists; local operations teams in Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East; hires from Google and Naver

product.summary: A global learning platform combining the 'QANDA' app, which instantly shows step-by-step solutions when a math problem is photographed, with 1:1 AI and human tutor matching. Surpassed 80M+ cumulative users in South Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East
product.problem_statement: In math learning, the 'solution process' is key, not just the answer, but students have no one to help when they get stuck. Private education costs are high, and access to institutes and tutors varies greatly by region
product.solution: Offers a free step-by-step solution engine combining math problem OCR, proprietary solution database, and LLM; generates revenue through premium features such as 1:1 tutor matching and AI tutor. Expands globally with localized content for Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East
key_features: QANDA Search: Search solutions with a single photo
QANDA AI Tutor: GPT-based 1:1 learning tutor
QANDA Tutor: 1:1 human tutor matching
QANDA Study: Learning management and planner
Multilingual content (Japanese, Southeast Asian, Middle Eastern)
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Math formula OCR, solution database matching, LLM-based step-by-step explanation generation, multilingual content pipeline
product.target_customer: Middle and high school students and parents in South Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East; college entrance exam preparers
product.business_model: Premium subscription (AI tutor/tutor matching) + advertising + partnerships with institutes and content providers
